Aisha Khan: Heads up — hiring wants to offer a senior infra contractor (Europe-based) at 14% above S3 cap for a 5-month engagement. Candidate prefers EUR invoice. Start target 2026-07-12. Manager requests a one-time relocation laptop stipend and accelerated NDA clearance.
Diego Ramos (Hiring Manager): Candidate is critical for shard routing and KV cache work; ramp time zero. Proposing EUR 95k annualized pro-rated for 5 months + EUR 1,200 one-time equipment stipend. No benefits; short contract.
Clare O'Neill (People Ops): Geo-premium >10% triggers finance director approval. Also need payroll vehicle: EoR vs contractor invoicing. If invoiced, we need VAT setup. Please confirm cost center and PO.
Tom Briggs (Finance): Include cost_center and budget_owner. Also specify total EUR cash. Director sign-off needed for >10% exceptions. Ping @offers-bot to create a ticket to track approvals.
Aisha Khan: cost_center: ENG-RUNTIME-303, budget_owner: Diego Ramos, total cash EUR 39,583 (pro-rated) + EUR 1,200 stipend = EUR 40,783 gross. No PO (contractor). Added short market rationale to docs: "scarce serving infra + low ramp time; critical 5-month unblock".
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9155. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> legal. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9155
Tom Briggs: Provisional OK pending legal review of contractor structure and confirmation of gross EUR equivalence if using EoR. Director approval step required; I'm looped in.
Clare O'Neill: Legal note — if candidate invoices from an EU entity, confirm supplier onboarding and AML docs. Also recommend NDAs and IP assignment language; add clause about no benefits/limited scope.
Diego Ramos: Added NDA + IP clause draft to ticket. Can we get a fast-track director approval? This hire unblocks a production rollout.
Tom Briggs: Director approved provisional uplift. Final sign-off after legal confirms supplier docs. :white_check_mark:
Clare O'Neill: I'll request supplier onboarding and add the standard contractor addendum: if conversion happens within 90 days, tax/benefit review applies. ETA to finalize offer: EOD tomorrow if supplier docs are OK.
Aisha Khan: Thanks — People Ops will send the offer once legal and supplier onboarding clear. offers-bot: APP-9155 updated at 3001234599.
